receipts.description: Money the government took in that month, in US dollars.

reduction_of_operating_cash.description: How much was covered by drawing down the Treasury's cash, in US dollars. Negative when cash grew. Null before 2015.

get_revenue_collections.description: Get the money the federal government collected each day, to the cent: taxes collected by the IRS and other fees and payments, split by how they were paid (internet, bank, mail or over the counter). Figures go back to October 2004. No API key required.
get_revenue_collections.name: get_revenue_collections

parameters.description: Only include figures from this date onwards. Leave blank to go back as far as the data goes.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only include figures up to and including this date. Leave blank for the most recent.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Only this kind of money. Leave blank for all of it.
parameters.name: tax_category

options.label: Other money collected by the IRS

parameters.description: Only money paid this way. Leave blank for every way.
parameters.name: channel

parameters.description: Which end of the date range to start from. Newest first by default.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: How many rows to return, from 1 to 1000. 10 by default.
parameters.name: limit

collections.description: One row per day, revenue type, payment channel and electronic category.

date.description: The date the figures are for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

electronic_category.description: Whether it was collected electronically, such as 'Fully Electronic - All' or 'Non-Electronic'.

net_collections.description: The money collected, less any refunds of it, in US dollars.

count.description: How many rows came back in this step.

total_matching.description: How many rows match the filters in all. When it is larger than the count, raise Limit or narrow the dates to see the rest.

get_tax_refunds.description: Get the income tax refunds the Treasury paid each day, to individuals and to businesses, with month and fiscal-year totals, from the Daily Treasury Statement. Figures go back to October 2005 and are rounded to the nearest million dollars. No API key required.

parameters.description: Only include figures from this date onwards. Leave blank to go back as far as the data goes.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only include figures up to and including this date. Leave blank for the most recent.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Which end of the date range to start from. Newest first by default.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many rows came back in this step.

days.description: One row per business day, in the order chosen in Sort.

business_refunds.description: Refunds paid to businesses that day, in US dollars. Can be negative when earlier refunds are corrected.

business_refunds_fiscal_year_to_date.description: Refunds to businesses so far this fiscal year, in US dollars.

business_refunds_month_to_date.description: Refunds to businesses so far this month, in US dollars.

individual_refunds.description: Refunds paid to individuals that day, by direct deposit and by check, in US dollars.

total_refunds.description: Income tax refunds paid that day to individuals and businesses together, in US dollars.

description: Pull official U.S. federal finance figures from the Treasury's Fiscal Data: the national debt to the penny and back to 1790, the debt limit, the Treasury's daily cash, deposits, withdrawals, tax refunds and revenue collections, the monthly budget deficit and where the money comes from and goes, interest on the debt, Treasury auction results and schedules, official exchange rates, I bond rates and the nation's gold reserves. No account or API key required.
